films.title: 25 and Under: An introduction to John Woo
films.description: Are you a member of our 25 and Under scheme? Join us for a free introduction to director John Woo.

tags: Bullets and Brotherhood: The Films of John Woo

films.title: 25 and Under: An Introduction to Marilyn Monroe
films.description: An introduction to one of Hollywood’s most iconic stars.

films.title: UK Premiere of 4K Restoration: Bashu, the Little Stranger
films.cast: Adnan Afravian, Susan Taslimi, Parviz Poorhosseini
films.description: The bond between an orphan and a strong, independent woman who defies tradition and authority lies at the heart of this drama by a filmmaker whose work was subject to censorship.

films.title: A Better Tomorrow
films.cast: Ti Lung, Leslie Cheung, Chow Yun-fat
films.description: This tale of two brothers on the opposite sides of the law marks the emergence of John Woo’s signature action filmmaking style.

tags: Bullets and Brotherhood: The Films of John Woo

films.title: BFI Member Quiz
films.description: Come test your film knowledge against other BFI Members.

films.title: Bicycle Thieves
films.cast: Lamberto Maggiorani, Enzo Staiola, Lianella Carell
films.description: Vittorio De Sica’s moving neorealist masterpiece tells the story of a family man in post-Second World War Rome whose livelihood hinders on recovering his stolen bicycle.

films.title: Blue Heron
films.cast: Eylul Guven, Iringó Réti, Adam Tompa, Edik Beddoes
films.description: In her astonishing and award-winning feature debut, director Sophy Romvari constructs a personal portrait of memory, childhood and family.

films.title: Breaking Away
films.cast: Dennis Christopher, Dennis Quaid, Daniel Stern, Jackie Earle Haley
films.description: This Academy Award-winning coming-of-age tale sees four endearing young men finding their direction with a little help from a bicycle relay race for the ages.

films.title: Bullet in the Head
films.cast: Tony Leung Chiu-wai, Jacky Cheung, Waise Le
films.description: This Vietnam war melodrama is an underrated and emotionally devastating masterpiece in John Woo’s filmography.

tags: Bullets and Brotherhood: The Films of John Woo

films.title: Bus Stop
films.cast: Marilyn Monroe, Don Murray, Arthur O’Connell
films.description: Marilyn Monroe is an unvarnished singer evading an overly keen cowboy in this romantic comedy-drama.

films.title: Bus Stop
films.cast: Marilyn Monroe, Don Murray, Arthur O’Connell
films.description: Marilyn Monroe is an unvarnished singer evading an overly keen cowboy in this romantic comedy-drama.

films.title: Cactus Pears
films.cast: Bhushaan Manoj, Suraaj Suman, Jayshri Jagtap
films.description: Rohan Parashuram Kanawade’s debut feature is a sensitive romantic drama exploring grief, tradition, longing and the realities of lower-class queer life in India.

films.title: Clash by Night
films.cast: Barbara Stanwyck, Robert Ryan, Paul Douglas, Marilyn Monroe
films.description: Marilyn Monroe impresses as a naïve small-town girl in Fritz Lang’s dark melodrama fraught with sexual tension.

films.title: Cyclone
films.cast: Helena Albergaria, Magali Biff, Rogério Brito
films.description: A working-class playwright battles patriarchy and scandal to claim her future in early-20th-century São Paulo.

films.title: Dogtown and Z-Boys
films.description: The godfather of the skateboard documentary charts the history of the subculture from the streets of mid-70s USA to the present day.

films.title: Dona Flor and Her Two Husbands
films.cast: Sônia Braga, José Wilker, Mauro Mendonça
films.description: Sonia Braga dazzles in this sensual and hugely popular classic.

films.title: Don’t Bother to Knock
films.cast: Marilyn Monroe, Richard Widmark, Anne Bancroft
films.description: Marilyn Monroe thrills as an unstable babysitter in British director Roy Ward Baker’s psychological thriller.

films.title: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
films.cast: Jane Russell, Marilyn Monroe, Charles Coburn, Elliot Reid
films.description: Marilyn Monroe and Jane Russell make a magnetic duo as two showgirls pursuing a match in Howard Hawks’ classic comedy musical.

films.title: Ghatak Was Here
films.description: A personal essay film about the life, death and resurrection of the great Bengali director Ritwik Ghatak.

films.title: Hamlet
films.cast: Riz Ahmed, Art Malik, Joe Alwyn, Timothy Spall, Morfydd Clark
films.description: Riz Ahmed is riveting as a very modern Hamlet in Aneil Karia’s thrilling adaptation of Shakespeare’s play.

films.title: Happy Together
films.cast: Tony Leung Chiu-wai, Leslie Cheung
films.description: Wong Kar Wai’s emotive and beautifully shot drama about a turbulent relationship makes the most of its Buenos Aires backdrop.

films.title: Hard Streets – Working Class Lives in Charlie Chaplin’s London with Jacqueline Riding
films.description: From Edwardian poverty to cinematic genius, Jacqueline Riding explores how Chaplin’s Lambeth roots, radical politics and street culture shaped his films and enduring worldview globally.

films.title: Hard Target
films.cast: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Yancy Butler, Lance Henriksen
films.description: In John Woo’s Hollywood debut, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as the sole hope for a group of people being hunted as game by the ruthlessly rich.

tags: Bullets and Brotherhood: The Films of John Woo
Bullets and Brotherhood: The Films of John Woo
Bullets and Brotherhood: The Films of John Woo

films.title: How to Marry a Millionaire
films.cast: Marilyn Monroe, Betty Grable, Lauren Bacall
films.description: In this hilarious comedy, Marilyn Monroe teams up with Betty Grable and Lauren Bacall on a mission to marry wealthy suitors.

films.title: In Search of the Sky
films.cast: Nikhil Yadav, Meghna Agarwal, Raghvendra Bhadoriya
films.description: An elderly couple in an Indian village struggle with prejudice towards their disabled son and make a journey to the country’s largest religious gathering in search of a solution.

films.title: Incomplete Works
films.description: Three incomplete films and a short documentary directed by Ritwik Ghatak.

tags: Revolutionary Cinema: The Passion of Ritwik Ghatak

films.title: In Which Annie Gives It Those Ones
films.cast: Arundhati Roy, Roshan Seth, Arjun Raina, Rituraj
films.description: A new restoration of this cult classic written by Arundhati Roy which captured the zeitgeist of student life in an architecture school in 1970s Delhi.

films.title: Red Cliff Part I + Red Cliff Part II
films.cast: Tony Leung Chiu-wai, Takeshi Kaneshiro, Zhang Fengyi, Chang Chen
films.description: Don’t miss your opportunity to see both parts of John Woo’s historical epic on the big screen.

tags: Bullets and Brotherhood: The Films of John Woo

films.title: Iracema: Uma Transa Amazônica
films.cast: Paulo César Peréio, Edna de Cássia, Lúcio Dos Santos
films.description: A once-banned, newly restored road movie captures a transforming Amazon.

films.title: It’s Love Again
films.cast: Jessie Matthews, Robert Young, Sonnie Hale, Ernest Milton
films.description: This ultra-stylish Jessie Matthews musical is a brilliant comedy of mistaken identity.

films.title: The Kid with a Bike
films.cast: Thomas Doret, Cécile de France, Jérémie Renier
films.description: A young boy’s parental abandonment sees him taken in by a kind stranger, in this humanist drama from the Dardenne brothers.

films.title: Khartoum
films.description: In this moving documentary, a collective of filmmakers capture the lives of a people caught up in a conflict that has ravaged Sudan.

films.title: The Killer
films.cast: Chow Yun-fat, Sally Yeh, Danny Lee
films.description: In one of John Woo’s finest Hong Kong films, Chow Yun-fat excels as a charismatic hitman defined by an unshakeable a moral code.

tags: Bullets and Brotherhood: The Films of John Woo

films.title: Kings of the Road
films.cast: Rüdiger Vogler, Hanns Zischler, Lisa Kreuzer, Rudolf Schündler
films.description: Wim Wenders’ remarkable road-movie follows two men as they travel through a country in the midst of momentous change.

films.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
films.cast: William Hurt, Raul Julia, Sônia Braga
films.description: Héctor Babenco’s Oscar-winning drama features outstanding performances by William Hurt and Raul Julia as two very different inmates in a Brazilian prison.

films.title: Ladies of the Chorus
films.cast: Marilyn Monroe, Adele Jergens, Rand Brooks
films.description: Monroe delivers a luminous performance in her first major role, in this long‑forgotten B‑movie musical.

films.title: Late Spring
films.cast: Setsuko Hara, Chishū Ryū, Yumeji Tsukioka, Haruko Sugimura
films.description: One of Yasujiro Ozu’s finest works, a quietly devastating drama that tells a story of love, sacrifice and loss between a daughter and a father.

films.title: Let’s Make Love
films.cast: Marilyn Monroe, Yves Montand, Tony Randall, Frankie Vaughan
films.description: Marilyn Monroe shines opposite French star Yves Montand in this musical comedy of deception and misunderstandings.

films.title: The Look of the 1960s: Barbarella and Pulp Pop Comics
films.description: Jan Baetens and Hugo Frey discuss the vibrant collision of pop art, comics and cinema in a decade of radical change.

films.title: Little Amélie
films.description: This outstanding, richly colourful animated work is set in late 1960s Japan and presents an infant-eye view of the world.

films.title: Lost Star – The Rediscovery of the Transnational Stardom of Belinda Lee with Steve Chibnall
films.description: Steve Chibnall uncovers a forgotten film star’s meteoric rise and fall, from English seaside fame to American exile, revealing postwar challenges to respectability and stardom.

films.title: Lúcio Flávio, o Passageiro da Agonia
films.cast: Reginaldo Faria, Ana Maria Magalhães, Milton Gonçalves
films.description: This thriller about a real-life criminal was a major visual reference for Kleber Mendonça Filho’s The Secret Agent.

films.title: Marilyn Monroe
films.description: Join us to explore the BFI Reuben Library’s trove of Marilyn Monroe books, images and paraphernalia.

films.title: Marilyn Monroe Study Day
films.description: Take a contextual deep dive into Marilyn Monroe with this dedicated day of talks and screenings.

films.title: Film Poster Bonanza
films.description: Stake your claim to one of our many must-have posters in this special auction.

films.title: The Men I Had
films.cast: Darlene Glória, Milton Moraes, Arduíno Colassanti
films.description: A once-censored, witty and radical portrait of female sexual autonomy.

films.title: Mid90s
films.cast: Sunny Suljic, Lucas Hedges, Katherine Waterston, Na-kel Smith, Olan Prenatt
films.description: Jonah Hill’s directorial debut takes us back to the era of tiny wheels and very big trousers.

films.title: The Misfits
films.cast: Clark Gable, Marilyn Monroe, Montgomery Clift
films.description: Marilyn Monroe’s final film is a poignant and poetic drama, infused with the promise of what could have been had she had more time to explore her skills as a dramatic performer.

films.title: My Foreign Land
films.description: Collective cinema rethinking land, identity and belonging from Indigenous perspectives.

films.title: Niagara
films.cast: Marilyn Monroe, Joseph Cotten, Jean Peters, Max Showalter
films.description: In this sensational noir, Marilyn Monroe’s unsettling antics disturb a honeymooning couple.

films.title: Night Train
films.cast: Lucyna Winnicka, Leon Niemczyk, Zbigniew Cybulski
films.description: Jerzy Kawalerowicz’s richly cinematic gem is one of the creative highlights of an extraordinary era of Polish cinema.

films.title: Ollie
films.cast: Kristen Billon, Théo Christine, Cédric Kahn, Emmanuelle Bercot
films.description: A young teenager, living in rural France, grapples with family tragedy through his friendship with two fellow skateboarders.

films.title: Pink Narcissus
films.cast: Bobby Kendall, Don Brooks, Charles Ludlam
films.description: This landmark experimental queer art masterpiece presents the erotically charged dreamscape of a young sex worker in a kaleidoscopic celebration of the male body.

films.title: The Prince and the Showgirl
films.cast: Marilyn Monroe, Laurence Olivier, Sybil Thorndike, Richard Wattis
films.description: Marilyn Monroe is an American chorus girl who snares a prince, in the first film produced by her own production company.

films.title: Platform
films.cast: Wang Hongwei, Zhao Tao, Liang Jingdong
films.description: Zhangke’s sophomore feature is widely considered one of the first masterpieces of 21st-century cinema.

films.title: Reason, Debate and a Story
films.cast: Ritwik Ghatak, Tripti Mitra, Shaonli Mitra, Bijon Bhattacharya
films.description: Autobiographical last film – and a critically intricate commentary on contemporary Bengal.

films.title: A River Called Titas
films.cast: Rosy Samad, Kaberi Choudhury, Roshan Jamil, Rani Sircar
films.description: Poetic depiction of memory, loss and a vanishing fishing community.

films.title: Rome Express
films.cast: Conrad Veidt, Esther Ralston, Hugh Williams
films.description: An opportunity to catch a ride aboard this criminally underseen British thriller.

films.title: The Runaway
films.cast: Param Bhattarak Lahiri, Padmadevi, Gyanesh Mukherjee, Kali Bannerjee
films.description: A story of discovery, longing and hardship in an indifferent city.

films.title: Runaway Train
films.cast: Jon Voight, Eric Roberts, Rebecca De Mornay
films.description: The very definition of existential cinema, Andrei Konchalovsky’s action masterpiece finds two escaped prisoners aboard an out-of-control train.

films.title: The Seven Year Itch
films.cast: Marilyn Monroe, Tom Ewell, Evelyn Keyes
films.description: Marilyn Monroe is a middle-aged man’s ultimate fantasy in this comedy by Billy Wilder.

films.title: Skate Kitchen
films.cast: Rachelle Vinberg, Dede Lovelace, Nina Moran, Ajani Russell, Jaden Smith
films.description: Crystal Moselle’s accomplished documentary traces the lives of a group of female skateboarding friends in New York.

films.description: A selection of shorts that were directed and supervised by Ritwik Ghatak.

films.description: A selection of new and classic shorts celebrating skateboarding culture.

films.title: Snowpiercer
films.cast: Chris Evans, Song Kang-ho, Tilda Swinton, Octavia Spencer
films.description: Bong Joon Ho’s first English language feature is a post-apocalyptic adventure set aboard an unstoppable train whose class-divided carriages stoke the fires of revolution.

films.title: Subarnarekha
films.cast: Abhi Bhattacharya, Bijon Bhattacharya, Madhabi Mukherjee, Geeta De
films.description: A Partition epic of separation, fateful encounters and new beginnings.

films.title: Stranger Than Paradise
films.cast: John Lurie, Richard Edson, Eszter Balint, Cecillia Stark
films.description: Billed as a new kind of American movie, Jim Jarmusch’s hugely impressive second feature leans into Ozu, Bresson and the avant-garde.

films.title: There’s No Business Like Show Business
films.cast: Ethel Merman, Marilyn Monroe, Donald O’Connor, Dan Dailey
films.description: Marilyn Monroe is a knockout in this musical comedy about a family of entertainers.

films.title: Tickets
films.cast: Carlo Delle Piane, Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Martin Compston
films.description: Ken Loach, Abbas Kiarostami and Ermanno Olmi deliver a masterclass in storytelling in this rarely seen but richly rewarding portmanteau film.

films.title: The Undeclared War Series 2
films.cast: Simon Pegg, Hannah Khalique-Brown, Siân Brooke
films.description: Join us for the return of Channel 4’s immense international cyberwarfare thriller.

films.title: Une femme est une femme
films.cast: Anna Karina, Jean-Paul Belmondo, Jean-Claude Brialy
films.description: Full of playful cinematic tricks, dizzying colour and anarchic humour, Jean-Luc Godard’s tribute to and interrogation of the American musical comedy reinvents the romantic triangle.

films.title: Wadjda
films.cast: Waad Mohammed, Reem Abdullah, Abdullrahman Algohani
films.description: This Saudi Arabian debut shows the rebellious Wadjda, her eyes set on the bicycle of her dreams, realise that financial independency is the path to freedom.

films.title: D-Punk
films.cast: Celeste Bell, Jemima Dury, Penny Pepper, Mat Fraser, Mik Scarlet
films.description: A raw, defiant documentary where punk and disability collide – challenging norms, reclaiming space, and rewriting who gets to be seen and heard.
